sentences.text: Heard on I.A. No.19765/2023, which is second application filed under section 397(1) of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the applicant for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

The applicant has been convicted by the appellate Court for an offence punishable under Section 16(i)(a)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for6 months with fine of Rs.1000/-, with default stipulation.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the trial Court has n o t properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record.
The maximum jail sentence awarded to the applicant is six months.
The disposal of this revision will take considerable time, therefore, the jail sentence of the applicant may be suspended and he may be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the application.

Heard learned counsel for the parties,
perused the records and the judgments of the Courts below.
The ground raised in this second application for suspension of sentence is that the cognizance of offence could not have been taken after the expiry of three years.

For this, the attention of this Court is drawn to para 17 of the impugned judgment of appellate Court, wherein the argument was raised regarding prohibition on cognizance after the expiry of four years, but that ground was not discussed and decided by the learned appellate Court.
The appellant was convicted for mis-branding under Section 7(ii)/16(1)(a)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act which is an offence punishable with a maximum term of three years' imprisonment.

Looking to the fact that the sample of food item was taken in the year 2006 and the report of public analyst was received in 2007 but the complaint was filed in the year 2011, this second application for suspension of sentence is allowed for the reason that this ground was not raised in the earlier application.

sentences.text: Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, this application is allowed subject to depositing fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned, the custodial sentence of the applicant shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail for securing his presence before the trial Court concerned on 06.11.2023 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this regard.
The applicant shall regularly appear before the trial Court during the pendency of this revision without fail.
I.A. No.19765/2023 is, accordingly, allowed and disposed of.
List the case for final hearing in due course.
